    return factorial(n) // factorial(n - k)

    total_n, modulus = map(int, read_line().split())
    if total_n == 1:
        print(0)
        return
    sequence = [1]
    total_sum = 0
    for i in range(2, total_n + 1):
        size = ((i - 1) * i) // 2 + 1
        new_seq = [0] * size

            right_idx = min(len(sequence) - 1, w)
            new_seq[w] = prefix_sum[left_idx] - prefix_sum[right_idx + 1]

            f_arr[w + 1] = (f_arr[w] - w * prefix_sum[w]) % modulus

            L_idx = jj + 2
            temp_b_value += (((e_arr[R_idx] - e_arr[L_idx]) * (i + 1 + jj) + (f_arr[R_idx] - f_arr[L_idx])) * sequence[jj]) % modulus
        for jj in range(len(sequence) - i):
            L_idx = jj + 2
            R_idx = i + jj
            temp_b_value += (((e_arr[R_idx + 1] - e_arr[L_idx]) * (i + 1 + jj) + (f_arr[R_idx + 1] - f_arr[L_idx])) * sequence[jj]) % modulus
        total_sum += (temp_b_value * get_perm(total_n, total_n - i)) % modulus
        sequence = new_seq
    print(total_sum % modulus)
